title: Menu Item — Megamenu Icon

fields.label: Megamenu icon
fields.name: menu_icon
fields.instructions: Only used for items shown as a card in the header megamenu (a 3rd-level item, or a 2nd-level item with no children). The grey line under the title is this item's own Description field — switch "Description" on under Screen Options if you don't see it.

description: The choices here are a placeholder: thinksme_menu_icon_choices() in functions.php replaces them at load time from thinksme_menu_icons(), so the icon list lives in one place and this file never has to be re-synced when an icon is added.
